body: scrollback.go: ring buffer (10,000 lines max), push/line/Len methods. vterm.go: Screen.sb scrollbackBuf + scrollTop int. scrollUp() now saves rows to buffer before clearing. Snapshot(): composites scrollback + live screen when scrollTop>0; cursor=-1/-1 when scrolled. ScrollBy/ScrollReset/ScrollLines/ScrollbackLen methods. cmd/pitviper/main.go: handleScrollKey() for Shift+PageUp/Down/Home/End. 17 vterm tests pass including TestScrollbackView and TestScrollByClamp.
